title: Renewal and Cancellation Schedule for Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions
content:
# Renewal and Cancellation Schedule

Schedule of the renewal and cancellation figures fixed for each tier of Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions.

| Tier | Renews automatically at term end | Renewal window opens before term end (calendar days) | Non-renewal notice must be received before term end (calendar days) | Escalation applied to the subscription fee at each renewal (percent) | Written notice before a cancellation takes effect (calendar days) | Fee on the unbilled remainder of the term when cancelled early (percent) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Utility Bill Tracking Subscription | yes | 45 | 30 | 5.0 | 30 | 20 |
| Metering & Dashboard Subscription | yes | 60 | 30 | 4.5 | 30 | 25 |
| Energy Analytics Subscription | yes | 60 | 60 | 4.0 | 60 | 30 |
| Fault Detection & Diagnostics Subscription | yes | 90 | 60 | 3.5 | 60 | 35 |
| Measurement & Verification Program | yes | 90 | 90 | 3.0 | 90 | 40 |
| Managed Energy Performance Program | no | 150 | 120 | 2.5 | 120 | 50 |


## Schedule notes

1. Automatic renewal applies at every tier except the Managed Energy Performance Program.
2. The renewal window figure is the number of calendar days before the term end date at which the window opens.
3. The non-renewal notice figure is the number of calendar days before term end by which a non-renewal notice must be received.
4. The escalation is the percentage by which the subscription fee rises at each renewal: 5 percent on the Utility Bill Tracking Subscription down to 2.5 percent on the Managed Energy Performance Program.
5. The cancellation notice figure is the calendar days of written notice before a cancellation takes effect.
6. The early cancellation fee is a percentage of the unbilled remainder of the term.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

An Energy Analytics Subscription renews automatically, opens its renewal window 60 days before term end, needs any non-renewal notice 60 days before term end, escalates 4.0 percent at renewal, needs 60 days of written notice to cancel, and carries a 30 percent fee on the unbilled remainder when cancelled early.
